title: OpenAI Drops GPT-6.2 Astra and Sol
hook: OpenAI just fired back in the AI model race.
script: OpenAI just fired back in the AI model race. One week after Anthropic launched Claude Fable 5.2, OpenAI released two new models: GPT-6.2 Astra and GPT-6.2 Sol. Astra is built for heavy professional work — documents, slides, code, even frontends for websites, games, and 3D design. Sol is the faster, everyday model, designed to handle more tasks on the same paid plan. The pricing tells a big story. Astra costs eight dollars per million input tokens and forty dollars for output. Sol is just two dollars in and ten dollars out. OpenAI says Astra sets a new quality bar for complex work — at a much lower price than before. The frontier race is not slowing down. It’s getting cheaper, faster, and more competitive.
